title: Corner-pass record (one JSON-Lines record in passes_<block>.jsonl)
description: Written by trace-rt when a pass closes (exit-gate crossing). One record per corner pass: raw metrics, per-element criterion booleans, per-corner qualification state, and the element-level controller stage at pass close. Metric/criterion fields are null when not measurable in that pass (e.g. no brake-initiation event found). Invalid laps' passes still feed the controller, flagged via valid=false.

max_wheels_outside.description: Worst wheels-outside count seen during the pass. The raw input to the wheels_outside validity gate, stamped so the gate's decision is reconstructible from the logs alone.

max_collision_depth_m.description: Deepest collision recorded during the pass, metres (ac.StateCar.collisionDepth), 0 when the car never touched anything. The raw input to the wall_contact validity gate. Logged because the gate is a THRESHOLD on this value, not a test for non-zero: a kerb graze is a collision of a few millimetres that costs no speed and is simply fast driving, while a barrier strike is deep and expensive. Without this field a wall_contact flag can only be second-guessed by inference from speed traces, which is how the first false positives were found.

brake_initiation_distance_m.description: Signed distance from the reference brake point at brake initiation, metres of track length (positive = EARLIER than the reference). null when no sustained brake application was found inside the corner's braking zone, or when the corner has no braking zone at all — a null is NO EVIDENCE, not a failure, and the pass does not enter the braking element's evidence window (M4 decision).

brake_initiation.description: The RAW brake-initiation sample (impl plan section 2.1.4): the session-clock time and spline position of the detected event. Stamped so the pilot's event-log audit can reconstruct the braking gate's exact input from the logs alone — the 20 Hz tick log cannot resolve it, because the evaluator consumes per-frame samples.

brake_rolling_mean_distance_m.description: Rolling mean of this corner's PRIOR brake-initiation distances (the passes forming the current qualification window), which is the consistency gate's datum. null on the first pass of a corner, where there is no prior sample and the consistency gate is vacuously met.

peak.description: Peak brake input over the pass.

releases.description: Times brake input fell back below the initiation threshold after the initiation event, within the pass.

brake_modulation.description: Brake-pressure modulation summary. DESCRIPTIVE ONLY — framing v6 logs it and does not gate on it. null when no brake initiation was detected.

apex_rms_m.description: RMS lateral deviation from the expert apex line over the corner's apex window(s), metres. Never a single-point sample at the gate (framing v6: that is noisy and gameable). A compound corner's several windows yield ONE value, taken over their union. null when the pass did not cover a whole window.

criteria.description: Per-pass, per-element criterion booleans — the unit the controller's 3-of-4 rule consumes. null means the metric was not measurable on this pass (no evidence): the pass does not enter that element's evidence window and cannot contribute a consecutive failure.

accuracy.description: Brake-initiation distance inside the corner's tolerance band.

consistency.description: Brake-initiation distance within the consistency delta of the corner's rolling mean. Vacuously true on a corner's first pass.

braking_gates.description: The braking criterion's two gates, logged SEPARATELY (eval plan v2, Session 2 outputs). criteria.braking is their conjunction. Separating them is what makes the 'consistent but inaccurate' learner — reliably 30 m early — visible in the data rather than only in the design rationale.

qualified.description: Per-corner qualification state for this corner after this pass.

stage.description: Element-level controller stage at pass close (computed in all modes; salience pinned in static mode).
